summary.intent: Complete gap-closure phases 42 (API unpin integrity), 43 (FUSE write durability), and 44 (IPNS conflict handling) for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone via the GSD manager loop: discuss → plan → execute → verify → close each phase sequentially.
summary.outcome: All three phases were fully discussed, planned, and executed (42: 8 plans, 43: 8 plans including gap closure, 44: 5 plans). Phase 42 was completely closed out. Phases 43 and 44 reached the re-verify stage with VERIFICATION.md files committed showing remaining gaps/UAT items, but phase.complete was not yet called for either.

repo: The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) is guarded only by JwtAuthGuard with open signup — any account holder can destroy another user's pinned content; the handler never reads req.user before calling Kubo pin/rm.

Kubo staging runs with the 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72), meaning provider records for every pinned CID are broadcast to the public DHT — CIDs are public identifiers by design.
writable-share.ts:450 drops prunedCids without calling unpin — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists, making every no-row unpin call either benign (race) or malicious.
BYO IPFS path was broken in both directions before phase 42: the advisory 'not pinned' response was not being swallowed on the BYO side.
GSD auto-manages per-phase feat/ branches; main and origin/main are never touched by plan/execute workflows.

pnpm/jest flag passthrough: `pnpm --filter @package test -- --testPathPattern=X` breaks because pnpm inserts a `--` separator that jest treats as a positional regex; must use `pnpm --filter @package exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`.
1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git commands; NEVER use --no-gpg-sign.
`cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp` cannot cross-compile on macOS due to pre-existing failures in windows-future and winfsp-sys registry crates — not related to phase changes.
GSD commit helper returns `committed: false` as a false negative while the commit actually lands — always verify via `git log`, never blind-retry.
cleanup-wave must be run from the repo root, not from inside a worktree; running from a worktree causes false `base_mismatch` errors because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent — already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun; write reduced manifests containing only remaining entries.
`nest build` (api:generate side-effect) produces formatting-only changes to openapi.json in the main tree that pollute worktree merges; must `git checkout --` before merging.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global pin/rm without ownership check — same cross-tenant data-destruction surface as the direct unpin endpoint. Rerouted through guardedUnpin in plan 42-05.

guardedUnpin added: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → row delete + refcount in transaction → pending_unpins outbox insert if last reference → commit → best-effort Kubo pin/rm post-commit. Cross-user attempts increment audit metric and return silent 2XX.
Drops prunedCids array after save without calling unpin — pre-existing leak; confirmed no cross-user unpin exists here. Deferred to a future phase.

Was receiving ipnsRecord and calling batchPublishIpnsRecords downstream; rewired in phase 44 to consume new updateFileMetadata CAS return shape {ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids} with baseChildren for three-way merge.

Had a spurious spawn_journal.remove() in the background upload thread creating an orphan window between upload success and parent-pointer publish (CR-08 mirror). Fixed post-verify by removing the call; mechanism (b) — replay on next mount is the authoritative cleanup path.

Kubo v0.40 with server profile and swarm port 4001 tcp+udp exposed; server profile only disables local-network discovery, keeps full public DHT participation — every pinned CID's provider record is publicly broadcast.
New pending_unpins table: id (uuid PK), cid (varchar 255 unique), created_at (timestamp) — intentionally no userId column (global outbox, not per-user).

Full rewrite in phase 43-01: JournalOp enum (UploadFile|MkdirPublish), persist-backed WriteQueue with put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay. Journal entries include parent_ipns_key_hex for IPNS re-publish on replay.

workflow: GSD worktree merge cleanup must run from repo root — running from inside a worktree causes false base_mismatch failures since the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent; on rerun, write a reduced manifest containing only entries not yet merged rather than reusing the full wave manifest.
Node.js node_modules and .husky/_ untracked dirs inside agent worktrees block cleanup-wave merge steps — subagent executor prompts should include explicit CLEANUP instructions for these artifacts.
GSD commit helper false negatives are common; always verify commit landed via `git log` before deciding to retry.
For RAM-constrained environments, subagents must always target specific test packages/patterns — never run full monorepo test suites.
Decision coverage gate requires literal `D-NN:` citation in plan must_haves sections — a prose reference to the decision ID is not sufficient for the mechanical grep.
When communicating analysis, answer the user's direct questions in plain prose first — never re-present the same option menu without answering the underlying question.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures mid-session ('agent returned an error / fatal: failed to write commit object') required user to restart the 1Password app; multiple commit retries needed.
GSD commit helper returns `committed: false` as a false negative — caused unnecessary retry confusion on multiple commits across all three phases.
Planner socket error mid-phase-42 planning ('socket connection was closed unexpectedly') after writing plans 01-03; required filesystem fallback and a continuation planner for plans 04-08.
cleanup-wave not idempotent — already-merged worktrees report branch_mismatch on reruns, requiring manual reduced-manifest workarounds for waves 2 and 3.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD in a resolved-but-uncommitted state; required manual `git commit --no-edit` to finalize, followed by manual worktree rm and branch -D.
openapi.json formatting drift (564+ lines) caused by nest build side effect polluted the wave-3 merge scope; required `git checkout --` restore before merging.
Two accidental user inputs ('touring wyatt web bossy') mid-execution interrupted the orchestration loop, requiring explicit 'please continue' recovery.
Two session limit hits mid-execution required context handoff and explicit continuation prompts.
zsh multi-glob rm abort: `rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules` fails entirely if any glob misses — single paths required.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed because the mechanical grep needs literal `D-07:` citation; required post-checker manual edit to 42-03-PLAN.md.
Phase-44 post-merge typecheck failures required rebuilding sdk-core dist before tsc could resolve types correctly.
open_items: Phase 43: 4 runtime UAT items in 43-UAT.md require manual human verification: (1) journal crash recovery on macOS FUSE, (2) MkdirConflict drain re-arms publisher, (3) WriteParked tray notification appears, (4) Windows replay-on-mount recovers parked writes.
Phase 44: VERIFICATION.md committed with gaps — re-verify needed after any gap closure plans are written and executed.
Phase 42: SECURITY.md missing — `/gsd:secure-phase 42` was flagged but not yet run.
Deferred: full pending-uploads UI showing queued/parked write count and retry button (noted in phase-43 CONTEXT as future improvement).
Deferred: BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring — BYO delete flows need provider.unpin injected so advisory rows are cleaned up on BYO nodes.
Deferred: writable-share prunedCids leak — shared-write.ts:450 drops pruned version CIDs without unpinning; pre-dates phase 42 and was out of scope.
Deferred: Rust FUSE IPNS conflict handling parity — phase 44 only covered TS SDK callers; D-09 explicitly deferred Rust path to a future phase.

phases 43 and 44 still need phase.complete called — the close-out pipeline (phase.complete query + roadmap annotation + PROJECT.md update + todo closure) was not reached in the transcript for either phase.
